"Champion" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Chicago Coin Machine Manufacturing Company in June 1949.

- Manufacturer: Chicago Coin Machine Mfg. Co.
- Years made: 1949
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Wood Rail, Basketball, Sports, Single level playfield
